2014.question: Read carefully the stanza given below and answer the questions that follow:
2014.prashna: नीचे दिए गए पद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और उसके बाद आने वाले प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें:
2014.context:
Whose herd with milk, whose field with bread.
Whose flock supply him with attire,
Whose trees in summer yield him shade, in winter fire.

sub_questions.2: From which poem have these lines been taken?
sub_questions.4: From where does he get his clothes?

anuprashna.2: ये पंक्तियाँ किस कविता से ली गई हैं?
anuprashna.4: उसे अपने कपड़े कहाँ से मिलते हैं?

2017.context: "Happy the man whose wish and care. A few paternal acres bound Content to breathe his native air in his own ground".

sub_questions.3: Who does the pronoun 'his' in the third line of the first stanza refer to?
sub_questions.4: What is the theme of the first stanza of this poem?

anuprashna.1: इस कविता की रचना किसने की है?
anuprashna.3: पहले छंद की तीसरी पंक्ति में 'his' सर्वनाम किसके लिए है?
anuprashna.4: इस कविता के पहले छंद का विषय क्या है?

2017.question: Read carefully the stanza given below and answer the questions that follow:
2017.prashna: नीचे दिए गए पद्यांश को ध्यान से पढ़ें और उसके बाद आने वाले प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें:
2017.context:
Happy the men whose wish and care.
A few paternal acres bound
Content to breathe his native air
in his own ground

sub_questions.3: Who does the pronoun 'his' in the third line of the first stanza refer to?
sub_questions.4: What is the theme of the first stanza of this poem.

anuprashna.1: इस कविता की रचना किसने की है?
anuprashna.3: पहले छंद की तीसरी पंक्ति में सर्वनाम 'his' किसे संदर्भित करता है?
anuprashna.4: इस कविता के पहले छंद का विषय क्या है?
